messages:
alex liu: Heads-up — compliance asked for a concrete export format for change events (who changed what, when, and the before/after). They want something we can hand to auditors and also make queryable internally. Thoughts on NDJSON vs CSV and retention buckets?
maria gonzalez: NDJSON + schema versioning imo. CSV flattens too much, loses nested details (like fields changed). NDJSON is saner for diffs. :+1:
jordan park: Agree NDJSON. Also need a standard 'actor' shape: {id,type,ip,service} and a clear resource identifier. Otherwise we get 50 variants.
samir rao: Main constraints: (1) storage cost for long retention, (2) ability to export partial ranges quickly, (3) PII redaction. Can we do streaming exports that apply redaction on the fly?
alex liu: @samir good call. We discussed streaming earlier but ops said it complicates compliance audits. They want an immutable export file that matches the audit trail exactly. Maybe offer both: a canonical batch export (immutable, signed) and a streaming feed for internal analytics.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled:audit-export-runner started export-job=job_2026_05_22_01 id=az-42
maria gonzalez: For the canonical export we should include a schema header with version and SHA256 of the file, and use NDJSON line-per-event. Example event:```
{"ts":"2026-05-22T01:00:12Z","event_type":"change","actor":{"id":"u_123","type":"user","ip":"1.2.3.4"},"resource":{"type":"route","id":"r_456"},"change":{"field":"quota","before":"1000","after":"5000"},"ctx":{"request_id":"req_88","service":"console"}}
```
jordan park: Nice. Add an optional "sensitive_fields_masked": ["credit_card","ssn"] and a `redaction_version` so we can tell how it was masked in case of later legal requests.
samir rao: How do we map retention to customer plans? We promised 90 days for self-serve and 7 years for enterprise. Do we generate separate files per tenant/plan? That might blow up small tenants.
alex liu: Proposal: export sharding key = tenant_id. For self-serve we keep 90-day canonical bundles in cold storage (GCS glacier), enterprise bundles flagged with longer retention and faster retrieval SLA. Also store indexed metadata in BigQuery for quick queries (no PII there — just pointers).
maria gonzalez: On the indexing point: we should index by actor_id, resource_id, event_type, and timestamp. Keep the payloads in raw files. Search returns pointers to files + line offsets. That keeps the index small.
jordan park: What about streaming export format? Use Kafka topic per-shard with the same NDJSON payload but with a `mutable` flag false. internal consumers can subscribe. We should annotate events with `export_id` and `file_sha` when stable.
alex liu: API design question: do we expose a single audit-export API that supports `format=ndjson|csv` and `mode=canonical|stream` and `since`/`until` filters? Or split endpoints?
samir rao: Single endpoint with strict validation. If `mode=canonical` we only allow `format=ndjson` (no CSV). If `mode=stream` we support JSONL and Avro for consumers.
maria gonzalez: Also need to include a signed manifest for canonical exports: file list, sizes, checksums, schema_version, tenant_id. Auditors expect a manifest.
jordan park: UX for Console: under Admin -> Audit logs -> Export, show preflight estimate: file size, expected time to generate, retention label, and a checkbox for redaction. Keep it minimal.
alex liu: Implementation tasks: 1) define canonical event schema + version doc, 2) implement export runner + manifest signer, 3) indexing pipeline with minimal metadata, 4) Console UX for export request + estimate, 5) RBAC + tenant retention enforcement. Who wants what?
maria gonzalez: I can draft the schema and manifest spec (PR this week).
samir rao: I'll prototype the signed manifest and storage layout. Will validate cost model for 90d vs 7y.
jordan park: I'll own Console UX and the export API surface.
alex liu: Great. I'll put together an RFC with examples and the NDJSON canonical file format. Quick question: should we allow patch-level diffs (only changed fields) versus whole-object snapshots? Auditors often want both.
maria gonzalez: Include both: event.change for patch diffs, and an optional `resource_snapshot` for full state when available. Make snapshot optional to save space.
ops-bot: note: audit-export-runner completed job=job_2026_05_22_01 status=success artifacts=10 files total_size=1.2GB
alex liu: Perfect — thanks team. I'll create the RFC and tag you all. If anyone has regulator-specific requirements (EU DSAR, PCI) drop them in this thread.
audit-bot: policy-check: export_contains_pii=false, retention_policy=90d, enterprise_flag=false
